szoveg_eredeti:
This month, Henning Larsen and Krea came together in New York.

Over 100 architects, designers, and the people building the tools gathered for an evening of installations and conversation, all trying to figure out what AI should and shouldn't mean for one of the oldest creative disciplines: architecture.

 Eric Ball AIA and Nitsan Bartov spoke about why Henning Larsen chose to help shape these tools rather than wait to see what they become.

 Diego Rodriguez Prado shared why Krea is betting on architecture and why we believe the best tools are built side by side with the people who know the craft. Christian Venables followed with a live look at Krea 3 and the Krea agent.

After the talks, the room opened up to a series of 360° installations: Henning Larsen projects, reimagined with Krea.

We're grateful to the Henning Larsen team for opening the door to their practice, and for the care they bring to this partnership.

Thank you to everyone who joined us. More to come.
